feature_name: DataTable Header Height Reactive Update Fix
description: Implement a fix for the DataTable widget to properly handle reactive updates to the `header_height` property. Currently, changing this value while the table is displayed causes visual glitches and can crash the application when the cursor is positioned on the bottom row. The solution should ensure smooth visual updates and prevent crashes during property changes.
functional_requirements: Update the DataTable's layout logic to correctly recalculate and redraw the table header when the `header_height` property changes reactively
Ensure cursor positioning remains valid and doesn't cause index errors when the header size changes during user interaction
Prevent application crashes that occur when increasing `header_height` while the cursor is on the bottom row of the table
Maintain proper visual alignment between the table header and data rows during and after reactive property updates
